Vectors and planes in space

Worked solution

Exercise

Does A(1,2,3) lie on x + 2y − z − 2 = 0? Give a normal vector.

Problem

Find the plane through A(1,0,2) with normal vector (2,−1,3). Check A.

Worked solution

1 + 4 − 3 − 2 = 0, so A lies in the first plane, whose normal is (1,2,−1). The second plane is 2(x − 1) − y + 3(z − 2) = 0, or 2x − y + 3z − 8 = 0. A satisfies 2 + 6 − 8 = 0.
